about.title: About and safety
about.intendedUseBody: Awan helps adults understand how their reproductive health is changing over time and when it may be worth speaking to a professional. It does not diagnose, predict fertility, or recommend treatment.
about.howRulesWorkBody: Every output is generated by a written, deterministic rule engine with no AI in the decision. Every result card shows the exact rule IDs behind it.
about.limitsBody: Thresholds follow common public guidelines and are marked unreviewed until a clinician confirms them. A web-app lock provides discretion on a shared phone but is weaker than native OS encryption.
